category: Table Cell Shapes Subsystem Bug Fixes
scope: Fix cell shape lifecycle, positioning, index reordering, text coexistence, cloning, and cascading deletions across all Table API methods

tasks.title: Fix Initial Table Cell Shape Rendering in addTable and Placement in updateTableData
tasks.description: Fix issues #1 and #2. In TableManager.js and CellShapeManager.js, ensure addTable correctly parses polymorphic cell shape configurations during initial table generation. In updateTableData, fix the positioning and placement calculation for newly added or replaced cell shapes so that offset attributes, alignment, width/height, and placement (left/right/center) render accurately relative to the table cell bounds without failing silently.

tasks.title: Implement Deep Shape Cloning in cloneTable
tasks.description: Fix issue #3. When cloneTable duplicates a table graphic frame (<p:graphicFrame>), query all anchored cell shapes associated with the source tableId, duplicate their underlying <p:sp> nodes in <p:spTree>, recalculate offsets relative to the new cloned table coordinates, allocate unique shape IDs, and register them under clonedTableId.

tasks.title: Fix Dynamic Row Insertion Indexing and Shift Existing Cell Shapes in addTableRow
tasks.description: Fix issue #4. In addTableRow, when inserting a new row at rowIndex, shift the row index metadata of all existing cell shapes at or below rowIndex downward (rowIndex >= targetIndex -> rowIndex + 1). Ensure shapes are bound strictly to the target insertion index rather than the order of creation or last-modified row.

tasks.title: Fix Text and Shape Coexistence in addTableColumn
tasks.description: Fix issue #5. In addTableColumn, ensure both shape overlays and accompanying text are correctly added. When polymorphic column data provides shapes with outside text, ensure both the cell DrawingML text body (<a:txBody>) and the anchored shape node (<p:sp>) render without dropping the text runs.

tasks.title: Cascading Deletion of Cell Shapes in removeTable, removeTableRow, and removeTableColumn
tasks.description: Fix issues #6, #7, and #8. Implement cascading deletions of anchored shape nodes (<p:sp>) from <p:spTree>: (1) removeTable must purge all shapes associated with the target tableId; (2) removeTableRow must purge all shapes in the removed rowIndex and decrement indices for rows below it; (3) removeTableColumn must purge all shapes in the removed columnIndex and decrement indices for columns to the right.

tasks.title: Cascading Shape Purging in clearRowData, clearColumnData, and clearCellData
tasks.description: Fix issues #9, #10, and #11. Ensure data clearing operations also purge associated cell shapes: clearRowData must remove all shapes across the specified rowIndex; clearColumnData must remove all shapes across the specified columnIndex; clearCellData must remove shapes anchored at (rowIndex, columnIndex).

tasks.title: Comprehensive Integration Tests & Showcase Verification
tasks.description: Write automated tests in tests/integration/tableCellShapesLifecycle.test.js covering all 11 bug scenarios. Verify with showcase/table_advanced.js and confirm that exported presentations trigger zero Microsoft PowerPoint repair warnings.
